name: Pastina ("Italian Penicillin" Egg & Broth Stars)
whyItWorks: Tiny star-shaped white pasta simmered directly in chicken bone broth, finished with a beaten egg, butter, and aged parmesan for instant soothing calories.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer pastina or orzo in chicken bone broth for 5 mins until tender, remove from heat, and whisk in 1 beaten egg, a pat of butter, and grated parmesan.
